steps.caption: The Payments page
steps.narration: Send your client a link, and get paid online. It starts on the Payments page.

steps.caption: The connected account
steps.narration: Your own Stripe account is connected here, with bank payments and cards switched on.

steps.caption: Search for the client
steps.narration: Under Take a payment, search for your client.

steps.caption: The invoice
steps.narration: Her open invoice is already picked.

steps.caption: The link
steps.narration: A secure link appears. Copy it, then text or email it to your client.

steps.caption: The client's invoice
steps.narration: Now the other side. This is that invoice, as your client sees it.

steps.caption: The client opens the link
steps.narration: Your link opens a secure checkout page. In this demo, it is a stand-in page.

steps.caption: Who, what and how much
steps.narration: It shows who they are paying, what for, and the amount.

steps.caption: Bank account or card
steps.narration: Your client chooses bank account or card.

steps.caption: Paid
steps.narration: They are back on the invoice. It says paid, and that you have been notified.

steps.caption: Back to Payments
steps.narration: Back to your own Payments page.

steps.caption: Recent payments
steps.narration: The payment is at the top of Recent payments, marked succeeded.

steps.caption: Invoices
steps.narration: And on Invoices, that invoice is now marked paid.

steps.caption: INV-1999 is paid
steps.narration: Nothing to type in, and nothing to chase.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: You will find Payments in the left menu of your CRM.

youtube.title: How to send a payment link and get paid online | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Create a secure payment link for an open invoice in ConstructHUB CRM, send it to your client, and watch the payment land on your Payments page. The walkthrough uses a demo company and a demonstration checkout page in place of the real hosted checkout.
